comments: Accessibility evaluation is part of Damdit’s broader website audit. Findings include affected pages, evidence and suggested fixes. Audit comparisons help users track resolved and recurring issues. Automated checks do not establish full WCAG conformance and should be complemented by manual accessibility evaluation.
features: Damdit is a desktop website auditing tool with automated accessibility checks for text contrast, image alternatives, accessible names, page structure and ARIA.
